'''Dooba''' was a [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]] who looked after a young [[Unidentified child (Branli)|child]]. The child's [[Plasticene/Legends|plasticene]] [[Doll/Legends|doll]], [[Branli]], ended up with a broken finger after a fall from a [[grav slide]]. Dooba fixed the doll's finger for the child.<ref name="GFT" />
